Wearables

See your activity in context.

Continuous Glucose Monitoring

Glucose, with the day around it.

Review supported glucose information alongside meals, movement and your own notes. Source compatibility, reporting availability and plan eligibility require confirmation.

A supported CGM and an approved connection are required; no device is connected on this website.

Questions about connecting.

Do I need a wearable to begin?
A wearable is optional. Your goals, existing records and everyday inputs can provide a starting point.
Which wearables and CGMs are supported?
The approved compatibility list has not been supplied for this preview. No specific brand, model, region or CGM integration is promised here.
Can I connect a device on this website?
No. Device authorization and synchronization belong in the approved Orb app flow. This website explains the experience.
Can I use reports I already have?
Existing reports are part of the intended Health Vault experience. Confirm accepted formats and the released upload and sharing controls in Orb.
